name: conductor-okf
description: Independent context-driven spec/plan/TDD track workflow with the runbook layer built in. Originally derived from claude-conductor 1.2.0, now detached and self-maintained: the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) convention is baked into every context and track file, tracks carry prebaked file partitions for agent parallelization, and the handoff/slice skills own conductor/RUNBOOK.md end to end — session handoff, rolling checkpoints with recorded review verdicts, and conflict-free parallel fan-out planning. Upstream is no longer tracked or merged.
